scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,panel -c blue,magenta "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:panel"
scripts.lint: bun run --filter api lint && bun run --filter panel lint
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter api typecheck && bun run --filter panel typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --filter api test && bun run --filter panel test
scripts.gen:api: bun run --filter api openapi:export && bun run --filter panel gen:api
